_what: The ONE model route. Every caller — email, static ads, pages, video — routes through this table, so nobody chooses a model in their own code any more. It is read, never hard-coded: `image_production/route.py` walks `route` top to bottom and takes the first row whose `when` matches, then looks the model up in `models`. MODEL IDS COME FROM THE HOUSE (LD-78 (house picture models)): no row here names its vendor model — `route.table()` fills each row's `vendor_model` from components/generative-model-house (gpt-image-person ← pictures.generate, gpt-image-edit ← pictures.edit, gemini-image-object ← pictures.object, judge ← behind.judge) and records the job in `house_job`; a job the house does not answer, or a house door that is not the row's `provider`, is refused by name. This table keeps the doors: endpoints, params, sizes, key.
_why: RULE ROUTE-1: one route table decides which model makes a picture; no caller picks a model privately. Inputs: a picture request (purpose, direction, frame, references). Output: the model row and the reason. Every row names its registry entry, or says plainly that the registry has none.
_curator: RULE ROUTE-2: this table is curated apart from components/models/models.json. The registry says what the company may call; this table says what a picture routes to. The registry is read here and never edited from here.
_keys: A key is read by NAME, never by path: the process environment first, then the .env file at the repo root (add NAME=value there), through components/keys/loader.py. No key is ever read out of a file in the repo or the home folder, printed, logged or written into a run record.

_route_ruling: RULE ROUTE-6: every picture, with a person in it or not, fresh or an edit, goes to GPT Image: one look across a batch, one set of quirks, one prompt style. gemini-image-object stays declared as an alternate, never routed to. It takes no mask, which is why a region edit cannot be its job.

gate._what: RULE GATE-1 (inputs are hard): every NEW picture carries its variable sheet (a recipe). A picture call with no recipe, or a recipe with a blank, is refused by name before it reaches any door. It applies to plain.make for kind `picture` (static ads, the Prompt Bench) and to the engine for the purposes in recipe_required_purposes; not to an edit of a picture (governed by its approved base and its own change request), not to emails, and not yet to a carousel slide (kind `slide`: no slide sheet exists; listed in recipe_kinds_without_sheet until one does). RULE GATE-2: a picture we made may only be a reference or an edit source with a record: approved, chosen (a path with no output judge is its own chosen attempt), or scored below_criteria, which is allowed and carries its flag; one never chosen or judged is refused. RULE GATE-3 (outputs never hold a flow): max_attempts.pictures attempts in total across the ladder, each judged and scored; the best (tie: the later) goes forward, flagged below_criteria with its failed checks if it did not pass.
